title: omicau: independent benchmark protocol
description: Prospective v1.0.0 protocol for an independent, compute-efficient evaluation of omicau's multi-omics audit diagnostics and predictive benchmarking workflow. Simulations are independent units; real cohorts use repeated nested group-aware cross-validation. External methods are restricted to a prespecified simulation subset. Every run made before the successful freeze is pilot-only and excluded from definitive evidence.

creators.name: Tuna Birgün
creators.affiliation: Istanbul Technical University, Graduate School, Department of Molecular Biology - Genetics and Biotechnology, Türkiye

notes: This is a brand-new independent record. No prior Zenodo record, pilot output, pilot seed, or pre-freeze result is part of the definitive evidence package. DOI and publication date must be replaced from the new Zenodo record before freeze.
